1758 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 05-22, remaining days in 1758:  
May: 9 days (22 to 31 inclusive)  
Jun: 30, Jul: 31, Aug: 31, Sep: 30, Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31.  
Sum = 9 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 223 days.  
325 - 223 = 102 days into 1759.  
1759 is common year, Jan 31, Feb 28 → 31+28=59 days, leaving 102-59=43 days into March.  
March 31 days, so April 12 (since 43-31=12).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1759-04-12
